create_LTX2HDRPipeline: create an LTX2HDRPipeline instance for HDR video generation with reference video conditioning
run_LTX2HDRPipeline_call: run the LTX2HDRPipeline __call__ method to generate HDR video from reference conditions and text prompt
build_LTX2HDRReferenceCondition: build an LTX2HDRReferenceCondition dataclass with reference video frames and strength for HDR IC-LoRA conditioning
prepare_LTX2HDRPipeline_latents: prepare video latents with HDR IC-LoRA reference-video conditioning in the LTX2HDRPipeline
encode_LTX2HDRPipeline_prompt: encode text prompts into Gemma3 text encoder hidden states for the LTX2HDRPipeline
